tools.name: recall_repository_memory
tools.description: Recall verified behavioral contracts before changing a repository. Returns claims, scope, provenance, boundaries and regression hashes.

change.description: The proposed code change or behavior being investigated.

repository.description: Optional repository key used to restrict recall.

semantic.description: Use one budgeted Qwen embedding batch; disable for free lexical recall.

tools.name: audit_repository_revision
tools.description: Upload the current local repository revision, replay selected Memory Capsules in Nebius Sandboxes, and wait briefly for a preserved/violated/uncertain verdict.

repository_path.description: Repository directory at or below the MCP process working directory.

change.description: Description of the proposed revision being audited.

wait_seconds.description: How long to poll before returning the durable job ID.

analyze_conflict.description: Ask Nemotron Super to explain a replay conflict.

prepare_dependencies.description: Build a dependency image; disable for self-contained revisions.

allow_ultra.description: Permit a budgeted Ultra escalation for a high-risk conflict.
